notes.title: The Lion's Song Patch 4.2.2 + a Preview of Our Next Game!
notes.content:
Dear players, friends and fans,

It’s been a while since you last heard from us. We have been busy!
First off, we are releasing a patch for The Lion’s Song that fixes an issue with unlocking achievements. 

UPDATED 2020-01-30:
-------------------------------------------------------------
General ([i]Windows & Linux[/i]):
-	Fixed an issue that prevented players from getting an achievement when using the re-decide feature. All achievements can now be unlocked.


[h3]A Preview of Our Next Game[/h3]
Behind the scenes we have been working on something new & unannounced. Please keep a close eye on our channels – more coming soon. 
Although we can’t wait to tell you about it, we’d like to leave you with this small preview for now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25504666/620cca487a9b877f473165339113026e2b6e6918.gif[/img]
[i]Democracy was never meant to last.[/i]


Subscribe to our newsletter at [url=http://www.flowercollectors.com]flowercollectors.com[/url] or follow us on Twitter [url=https://www.twitter.com/mipumi]@Mipumi[/url] for more updates about our next game. 

From Vienna with Love,

The Mi’pu’mi Team

notes.title: Community Poll - Episode 3: Results
notes.content:
Dear The Lion’s Song community,

The entire team would like to thank you all for your numerous participation in our community poll. Thanks for staying with us through all 3 weeks and for putting smiles on our faces while we were reading your questions.

Finally in the 3rd week we reached episode 3. We will now wrap up your questions, prepare them for localization and off they go into the game. Which means on the other hand the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/477030/The_Lions_Song_Episode_4__Closure/]4th episode - Closure[/url] is pretty close :-) 

Please stay tuned for the final chapter of our beloved The Lion's Song!

In the meantime please check out the results of last week's community poll! 

[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/827947822278894351/118A96D2B2A75BD9495A0DAF2F8943F39BC7360A/[/img]

[h1]Community Poll - Episode 3 Final Results[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]“Winner”[/b] of Question 1 (about Nikol) with [b]64,47%[/b]:
[b]--> What do you dream of doing?[/b]

[*][b]“Winner”[/b] of Question 2 (about Professor Nenner) with [b]77,63%[/b]:
[b]--> How did you feel when you discovered Em’s true identity?[/b]
[/list]

The team will make sure those questions make it into the final episode.

Thanks again for all your support and commitment for our little pixel art gem.

All the best from Vienna.

Yours
Mi’pu’mi

notes.title: The Lion's Song Community Poll - Episode 3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Vote and decide what happens in the finale of The Lion's Song![/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25504666/eca6da5899cd7daf95cce500136e64d434462305.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Thanks a million that you followed us so far :-) We really do appreciate all your input and are excited about the amount of returns we received over the last 2 weeks. Please stay on board for the last mile and complete with us this lovely 3 weeks journey about our beloved characters in The Lion's Song!
 
The poll continues this week with [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/477020/The_Lions_Song_Episode_3__Derivation/] Episode 3 - Derivation[/url]. Please help us to give Nikol and Professor Nenner even more depth, for an even better immersive playing experience. Dive into the story of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/477020/The_Lions_Song_Episode_3__Derivation/] Episode 3[/url] and think about interesting details you would like to know about those characters.

We would like to repeat and point out that we are really honored and also happy to be able to follow your view of the characters we gave birth to.

Don't miss your chance to participate!

The poll is open until Wednesday June 7th. We will then announce the outcome of this weeks poll and also summarize all previous questions. The winning questions will make it into The Lion's Song: Episode 4 - Closure.

Please check out the [url=https://de.surveymonkey.com/r/TheLionsSongCommunityPollEp3] survey[/url] and help us with [b][u]your[/u][/b] input!

[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/764896681223464552/0B548E20E2CF45FBB6CDC3EE19E7FAD2DEFFA144/[/img]

Yours,
Mi'pu'mi Team

notes.title: Community Poll - Episode 1: Results
notes.content:
Dear The Lion’s Song community,

Many thanks for all your support, feedback and ideas about [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/437160/The_Lions_Song_Episode_1__Silence/]The Lion’s Song: Episode 1 - Silence[/url] in the context of the final [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/477030/The_Lions_Song_Episode_4__Closure/]Episode 4 - Closure[/url].

The entire team enjoyed reading your questions and experiencing your angle to the story as well as characters. As we hoped, our emotional tale triggers different connecting factors for each player, allowing very individual experiences for everyone.

Hence we are very proud to present the first results of this 3 week journey :-)

[h1]Community Poll - Episode 1 Final Results[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]“Winner”[/b] of Question 1 with [b]37,11%[/b]:
[b]--> What was it like to talk to Nikol on the telephone?[/b]

[*][b]“Winner”[/b] of Question 2 with [b]42,27%[/b]:
[b]--> How is ONE WEEK enough to compose a masterpiece?[/b]
[/list]

The team will make sure that those questions make it into the final episode and we will work hard on good answers to shed a better light on Leos, Arthur and of course Wilma.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25504666/83490d0a13a298b805a0397ceb7ab7a5cf5ed014.png[/img]

Please stay tuned for the next community poll, covering [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/459140/The_Lions_Song_Episode_2__Anthology/]Episode 2 - Anthology[/url].

Thanks and all the best from Vienna.

Yours
Mi’pu’mi

notes.title: Episode 1 & 2 Update
notes.content:
Dear players, friends and fans!

With the release of “Episode 3 – Derivation”, we also updated “Episode 1 – Silence” & "Episode 2 - Anthology". As you already might know, the way you play Episode 3 affects scenes in Episode 1 and Episode 2 - and vice versa.
